hotels.name: Naeba Prince Hotel
hotels.notes: The base resort itself — four wings totalling ~3,000 rooms with direct lift access. Dragondola terminal is in front of the hotel; free shuttle to Echigo-Yuzawa Station.

hotels.name: NASPA New Otani
hotels.notes: Resort hotel attached to NASPA Ski Garden, ~10 min by shuttle from Echigo-Yuzawa Station. Good for travellers who want ski + town access without committing to the Naeba complex.

hotels.name: Hotel TEN to SEN
hotels.notes: Modern hotel a 2-minute walk from Echigo-Yuzawa Station. Convenient for travellers using multiple resorts on the Mt. Naeba ticket (Naeba, Kagura, NASPA).

hotels.name: Ryokan Yukiguni no Yado Takahan
hotels.notes: Historic ryokan where Kawabata Yasunari wrote 'Snow Country'. Hilltop location overlooking Echigo-Yuzawa; multiple onsen and a kaiseki dining program.

hotels.name: Kagura Mitsumata Lodge
hotels.notes: Small pension at the Mitsumata base of Kagura, the deep-powder side of the Mt. Naeba pass. Good base for early-lift backcountry-adjacent skiers.

hotels.name: Yuzawa Mannen-ya
hotels.notes: Family-run guesthouse a short walk from Echigo-Yuzawa Station. Tatami rooms and a small in-house onsen at a budget price.
